_comment.description: What is required to goal the game. Celestial is the hardest goal, requiring the player to reach level 35 and complete the pylons. Celestial (Through Practice) is a easier goal, allowing the player to goal through the Celestial Practice option.

description: Choose which class the player starts with.

By default, all obtainable upgrades are randomized as Seeds. Disable to exclude upgrades that only appear at Level 15 or later. Upgrades excluded by this option are written in italics in the Item Codex.
How many FRAGMENT OF BLOSSOM are randomized.
How many FRAGMENT OF BLOSSOM are required to goal. (Recommened to be ~10 less than total).

goal.description: What do you need to do to win this APWorld, once meeting all other requirements.

description: Include a ROOTS item for each class, which are a requirement for a class to goal. See summary and Item Codex for more info.
Adds 2 'Progressive Lower Difficulty's. When included, the player starts on Extreme, and can lower difficulty when the items are collected.
Adds Celestial Quests, which are an extra set of locations the player can enable. See summary for more info.
Allows the player to complete Celestial Quests through the Celestial Practice. With this off, you need to reach The Celestial through the Pylons at level 35+. Not for the faint of heart
Requires the player to have collected the required amount of FRAGMENT OF BLOSSOM before they can access Celestial Practice.
Requires the player to have collected all 'Progressive Ungate Levels' before they can access Celestial Practice.
Requires the player to have collected a matching class and ROOT item before they can access Celestial Practice. (Does nothing when randomize roots is off.)
Adds 'Progressive Fast Track' item(s). When included, the player start on normal runs, and can play Fast Track when one item is collected. All option includes Fast Track+

Includes a location for listening to each and every song in the soundtrack. (NOTE: Some songs in 'Full' only appear past Level 50. We STRONGLY discourage playing with Full OSTsanity unless you are ABSOLUTELY CERTAIN you (or your group) can handle it.)
Includes a location for selecting each and every curse (Does not include Greater Curses.)
